requirement:
修复管理后台 API 的数据模型不一致问题。
管理端的订单、用户、路线等接口返回的数据字段与前端不匹配。
需要统一管理后台各服务的数据模型。

details.name: ts-admin-order-service
details.rationale: Admin order service likely shares data models with basic info service for order-related admin APIs.

details.name: ts-admin-route-service
details.rationale: Admin route service likely shares data models with basic info service for route-related admin APIs.

details.name: ts-admin-travel-service
details.rationale: Admin travel service likely shares data models with basic info service for travel-related admin APIs.

details.name: ts-admin-user-service
details.rationale: Admin user service likely shares data models with basic info service for user-related admin APIs.

details.name: ts-travel-service
details.rationale: Travel service provides underlying travel data that admin travel APIs may consume, so data model changes could propagate.

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Order service provides underlying order data that admin order APIs may consume, so data model changes could propagate.

details.name: ts-user-service
details.rationale: User service provides underlying user data that admin user APIs may consume, so data model changes could propagate.

details.name: ts-route-service
details.rationale: Route service provides underlying route data that admin route APIs may consume, so data model changes could propagate.

details.name: ts-travel2-service
details.rationale: Travel2 service may also provide travel-related data used by admin APIs, potentially affected by model unification.

details.name: ts-preserve-other-service
details.rationale: Preserve other service also interacts with orders and users, potentially affected by model changes.

details.name: ts-cancel-service
details.rationale: Cancel service processes order cancellations, so data model changes in admin order APIs could affect it.

details.name: ts-wait-order-service
details.rationale: Wait order service manages queued orders, may share order data models with admin APIs.

details.name: ts-preserve-service
details.rationale: Preserve service interacts with orders and users, so data model changes in admin services could indirectly affect it.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Order other service handles alternative order flows, may share data models with admin order APIs.
